text_content: EU's Kaja Kallas declared Russia is no superpower. After over a decade of conflict, including four years of war in Ukraine, it has barely advanced beyond the 2014 lines.
Tel Aviv University announced a 15% cut to its research budget, prompting widespread protests from faculty and students across campus.
The mayor of Jerusalem inaugurated a new light rail line connecting the city center to the western suburbs, calling it a historic moment for the city.
The UN Security Council passed a resolution condemning the missile strikes on civilian infrastructure in the conflict zone.
Scientists at the Weizmann Institute discovered a protein that may reverse the aging process in muscle tissue.
